title: Surface artifact: opaque UI program bytes, verified by fingerprint
description: A container for browser UI code and its resolved dependency tree, crossing the Developer/Supply to Live-Run Data boundary alongside the artifact package but never inside it. This document never validates for meaning: each listed entry is a file path and a SHA-256 digest of its raw bytes, checked before use, and nothing about the file's content is parsed, typed, or interpreted here. That is the whole difference from artifact-package.v4: a package member is an identity pointing at a typed declarative citizen that hard-validates; a surface entry is a path and a fingerprint over bytes nobody reads for meaning. The manifest itself is the only thing this schema shapes.

build_command.description: The one fixed command a workspace runs against this artifact's entries to produce the served output. Recorded so the build is a declared, reviewable fact rather than an assumed convention.

entrypoint_html.description: The build output's relative path to the HTML document a viewing session navigates to. Produced by the build, not itself a shipped entry.

path.description: A relative path from the artifact's content root. Never absolute, never a parent-directory reference; the resolver additionally confines every entry to that root before reading its bytes.
